add_library(superroc_cache STATIC completion.cpp identity.cpp ledger.cpp checkpoint.cpp prefix_index.cpp slot.cpp retention.cpp disk.cpp disk_catalog.cpp streaming.cpp)
target_include_directories(superroc_cache PUBLIC ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_link_libraries(superroc_cache PUBLIC Threads::Threads)
if (BUILD_TESTING)
  target_compile_options(superroc_cache PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
  target_compile_definitions(superroc_cache PUBLIC SUPERROC_CACHE_TESTING)
endif()
if (SUPERROC_BUILD_TOOLS)
  add_executable(cache_ledger_bench ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/cache/ledger_bench.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(cache_ledger_bench PRIVATE superroc_cache)
endif()

if (SUPERROC_BUILD_TOOLS)
  add_executable(cache_prefix_index_bench ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/cache/prefix_index_bench.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(cache_prefix_index_bench PRIVATE superroc_cache)
  add_executable(cache_tiered_bench ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/cache/tiered_bench.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(cache_tiered_bench PRIVATE superroc_cache)
endif()
